ANKITA SCENE 1 · 06:20–06:29 AM

A02.1 — Rohan: The Stamina Joke

Walking track · Ankita × Rohan

APPROVED

Gurgaon ki January subah mein Gulmohar Heights ka walking track halki dhund se dhaka tha. Ankita fitted athletic jacket, running tights aur trainers mein brisk pace maintain kar rahi thi; uske lambe baal ponytail mein bandhe the.
Rohan: Good morning, Mrs. Discipline! New Year pe bhi koi chhutti nahi?
Ankita: Good morning, Mr. Excuses! Tum aaj time par kaise aa gaye?
Rohan: Tumse inspire hokar. Waise aaj tumhara sporty look kaafi suit kar raha hai—jacket, ponytail, confident walk. Society functions wali Ankita se different.
Ankita: Achha? Matlab normally boring lagti hoon?
Rohan: Compliment diya hai, madam. Cross-examination mat shuru karo.
Ankita: IT Tech Lead hoon. Har statement verify karti hoon.
Rohan: Fine. Confident, stylish, aur dangerously good at arguing.
Ankita: Dangerously? Itna dramatic mat bano. Waise tumhari stamina improve hui hai. Pehle do rounds mein excuses shuru ho jaate the.
Rohan: Stamina toh ab kaafi improve ho gayi hai. Do rounds ke baad bhi energy bachti hai… bas partner mein utna enthusiasm hona chahiye.
Ankita: Rohan! Hum jogging ki baat kar rahe hain… na ki night ex—
Ankita ekdum ruk gayi. Apni zubaan halki si daanton ke beech daba kar phir neeche ka honth bite kiya. Oh God, Ankita! Yeh kya bol diya? Usne nazar track ki taraf kar li.
Rohan: Night exercise? Maine toh morning stamina ki baat ki thi. Raat tumhare dimaag mein kaise aa gayi?
Ankita: Oh, shut up, Rohan!
Rohan: Morning ho ya night, tum hamesha itni competitive rehti ho?
Ankita: Tumhe har baat ka double meaning nikalna zaroori hai?
Rohan: Main? Tumne toh meri innocent baat ko completely different direction de di.

Ankita hans padi aur walk tez kar di. Baat mazaak mein rahi, lekin apni accidental slip ne use ek pal ke liye pleasantly fluster kar diya. Aage jogging track ke mod par Nikhil cooldown walk karta dikh gaya.
</article>

ANKITA SCENE 2 · 06:29–06:37 AM

A02.2 — Nikhil Joins: The Jacket Suspense

Walking track · Ankita × Rohan × Nikhil

APPROVED
06:29 par Nikhil, apni five-kilometre run ke baad, un dono ke pace se aa mila. Rohan abhi tak Ankita ke expression par muskur raha tha.
Nikhil: Happy New Year. Kya hua? Rohan ne subah-subah koi terrible joke maar diya?
Ankita: Terrible se bhi worse. Isko morning walk aur night workout ka difference samjhao.
Rohan: Dekha, Nikhil? Maine night ka naam bhi nahi liya tha. Madam khud topic lekar aayi hain.
Nikhil: Main toh five kilometres run karke aaya hoon. Tum dono ki conversation ka pace zyada challenging lag raha hai.
Ankita: Finally, someone sensible.
Rohan: Nikhil ko itni jaldi sensible certificate mil gaya?
Ankita: Usne abhi tak koi stupid double meaning nahi nikala.
Nikhil: Ek genuine compliment doon? Strong shoulders, defined waist aur itna steady posture—tumhari fitness genuinely noticeable hai. Athletic jacket bhi tum par achhi lagti hai.
Ankita: Oh… thank you, Nikhil. That was unexpectedly specific.
Rohan: Wah! Main style ki tareef karun toh investigation; Nikhil fitness ki kare toh thank you?
Ankita: Difference delivery ka hai, Rohan.
Nikhil: Compliment aur running commentary mein farq hota hai.
Rohan: Theek hai, ek din jacket ke bina black fitted sports tee mein walk karna. Phir dekhna, society ki morning attendance double ho jayegi.
Ankita: Achha ji? Fitness advice de rahe ho ya mere kapdon par research kar rahe ho?
Nikhil: Meri choice alag hai—midnight-blue sleeveless performance top. Tumhari shoulder definition aur posture clearly dikhega. You've worked for that fitness.
Rohan: Dekha? Dono agree karte hain: jacket ke bina sporty look impressive hoga. Bas suggestions alag hain.
Ankita: Wah! Ek fashion critic, ek fitness auditor. Dono married gentlemen hain, zara yaad rahe!
Nikhil: Bilkul yaad hai. Aur Rohan ko toh apni running se zyada tumhari jacket mein interest lag raha hai.
Rohan: Main toh bas soch raha tha—kal society mein rumor na fail jaaye ki morning walkers fitness se zyada fashion ke liye aa rahe hain.

Ankita ne jacket ki zip ko ungliyon se chhua, honth daba kar muskaan chhupayi aur halki laali ke saath un dono ki taraf dekha. Dono married neighbours ki itni direct tareef unexpected thi. Uske andar chhoti si excitement ki lehar uthi, phir usne apna confident tone wapas pa liya.
Ankita: Gentlemen, appraisal complete. Jacket meri hai, suspense tum dono ka.
Nikhil: Well played, Ankita.
Rohan: Okay, tum jeet gayi. Lekin next Monday ke step-count challenge ko bhoolna mat.
Ankita: Main nahi bhoolungi. Tum dono bas time par aana!

06:37. Ankita fitness corner ki taraf badh gayi. Na usne jacket utari, na koi promise kiya. Lekin apna hi jawab use dobara yaad aaya—Jacket meri hai, suspense tum dono ka. Woh halki si muskurayi aur stretching area ki taraf chal di.
</article>

A03 — Posture and Permission

Ankita: Abhi research chal rahi hai.

Vivek: Ankita? Breathing.
Ankita: Haan! Sorry. Tumhari instructions follow kar rahi hoon.
Vivek: Sure? Kyunki tum usually third rep tak mujhe correct karna shuru kar deti ho.
Ankita: Don't tempt me. Abhi bhi kar sakti hoon.
Vivek peeche hatkar agli repetition demonstrate karne laga.
06:47 AM

Vivek: Perfect timing. Tum bhi join karo. Arms open, chest up, shoulders back.

Vikram: Shreya ko mat batana. Woh toh poora interrogation shuru kar degi—kis taraf dekh rahe the, kyun dekh rahe the!
Vivek: Toh simple solution. Mere demonstration par focus karo.

Ankita: Thank you. Dekha, Vivek? Jab concentration wapas aati hai toh compliment bhi dhang se nikalta hai.

Vikram: Lagta hai next session mein wardrobe surprise milega.
Ankita: Surprise ki guarantee nahi. Lekin tum logon ki curiosity kaafi entertaining hai.
Vivek: Next time shoulder alignment phir check karenge. Aaj ka progress achha tha.
Ankita: Deal. Aur Vikram, next time counting practice karke aana.

ANKITA SCENE 4 · 07:03–07:18 AM

A04 — Two Brothers, Two Ways of Noticing

Malhotra residence · Breakfast table · Ankita × Karan × Aman × Rajeev

APPROVED

Continuity: A03 ends at 06:52 AM; Ankita reaches breakfast after a quick face wash, still in black athletic tee and running tights. Rohan, Nikhil, Vivek and Vikram are discussed, not present. A private family conversation is interrupted before its subject is disclosed.
07:03 AM

Ankita breakfast table par pahunchi. Chehra wash karne ke baad bhi uske baal halkay damp the. Black fitted athletic tee, running tights aur khuli jacket mein woh abhi workout se lauti hui lag rahi thi. Gardan ke paas paseene ki halki nami baaki thi.
Karan ne apni chai ka cup neeche rakha.
Karan: Good morning, Bhabhi! Aap workout karke aayi hain ya fitness competition jeetkar?
Ankita: Tum dono ko subah uthana hi mere liye sabse bada fitness challenge hai.
Karan: Mujhe lag raha hai aapke workout se zyada dangerous aapke comebacks hain.
Ankita: Aur tumhare excuses. Kal walk par chaloge?
Karan: Aap personally train karogi toh consider kar sakta hoon.
Ankita: Pehle alarm ke saath commitment nibhana seekho.
Aman laptop par interview questions dekh raha tha.
Aman: Bhabhi, Java backend interview call aaya hai. Shaam ko resume dekh lengi?
Ankita: Bilkul. Lekin interviewer ne concurrency poochha toh?
Aman: Phir confidently bolunga… next question please.
Ankita: Wonderful! Ab samajh aaya preparation kis level par hai.
Karan: Isko synchronized ka spelling aata hai. Implementation interview mein Google karega.
Aman ne use ghura. Ankita hans padi.
07:09 AM
Karan ne Ankita ke chehre par bani muskaan notice ki.
Karan: Waise Bhabhi, aaj kuch zyada hi happy lag rahi ho. Kya hua?
Ankita: Seriously, aaj sabko meri fitness aur kapdon mein itna interest kyun aa raha hai?
Karan: Sabko? Breakfast se pehle kaafi interesting encounters hue lagte hain!

Ankita ne Rohan aur Nikhil ki jacket-related teasing batayi—black fitted tee aur midnight-blue sleeveless ki alag-alag suggestions tak. Phir Vivek ke shoulder correction aur Vikram ke attention-control joke ka zikr kiya. Aman chup-chaap sunta raha, kabhi uski taraf dekhta, kabhi apne laptop ki screen par.
Jacket meri hai, suspense tum dono ka. Subah ka woh dialogue ab ghar ki breakfast table tak pahunch gaya tha.
Karan ki grin aur badh gayi.
Karan: Matlab subah se aapka fitness appraisal chal raha hai!
Ankita: Exactly! Aur tum us committee ke chairman banne ki koshish mat karna.

Karan: Late ho gaya, Bhabhi. Main toh kehne wala tha—aap ek din proper sports-bra workout look try karo. Gym ka advertisement ban jaogi. Seriously, very sexy! Main toh personally coach karne ko ready hoon.
Ankita ka haath chai ke cup par ruk gaya.
Ankita: Karan!
Karan: Arre, fitness campaign bola! Aapko personally coach karne ka offer bhi de sakta hoon.
Ankita: Tum apne push-ups toh complete kar nahi paate!
Karan: Woh toh jab motivation nahi hoti. Aap saamne khadi hokar counting karogi toh push-ups bhi badhenge… aur heartbeat bhi.
Ankita: Achha ji? Itna confidence?
Karan: Bet laga lo. Kal twenty perfect push-ups!
Ankita: Done! Haar gaye toh poora hafta mere saath morning workout. No excuses.
Karan: Aur jeet gaya toh?
Ankita: Tumhe certificate milega—Certified Show-off of Gulmohar Heights.
Karan: Certificate nahi, Bhabhi. Ek personal training session toh banta hai.
Ankita: Training milegi. Lekin trainer main houngi, rules bhi mere!
Woh hansi rokne ki koshish karte hue Karan ka kaan pakadkar halka sa kheenchti hai.
Ankita: Stupid! Badtameez kahin ke.
Uske gaal garam the. Subah ke compliments ke baad Karan ka itna confident challenge unexpectedly amusing laga.
Karan ab bhi hanste hue Aman ki taraf muda.
Karan: Beautiful lady ki tareef karna crime ho gaya? Aapki figure aur fitness ki appreciation toh banti hai! Aman, tu bata.
Aman kuch pal chup raha.
Aman: Bhabhi… aap genuinely fit lag rahi hain. Aur haan, aaj ka sporty look achha hai.
Karan: Bas? Agar bhaiya ki shaadi Bhabhi se nahi hui hoti toh—
Aman: Main kar leta.
Ek pal ke liye table par sannata chha gaya.
Ankita: Aman! Tum bhi?
Aman ki nazar turant laptop par chali gayi.
Aman: Woh… joke tha, Bhabhi.
Ankita ke pet mein halki butterflies wali feeling hui. Itna reserved Aman aisa joke karega, usne expect nahi kiya tha.
Subah se sabko kya ho gaya hai?
Uske gaal garam ho gaye. Woh muskurayi, lekin Aman ke serious expression ko samajh nahi paayi.
Ankita: Dono impossible ho! Ek overconfident, doosra secretly dangerous.
Usne dono ko playful thapki di.
Ankita: Chalo, breakfast finish karo. Aur Aman, shaam ko concurrency revise karenge. Marriage proposals nahi!
Karan hansne laga. Aman bhi aakhir muskuraya.
07:16 AM

Rajeev, jo breakfast ke dauraan zyada chup the, ne newspaper thoda neeche kiya. Unki nazar Ankita ke chehre se neeche uske fitted tee ke chest area par ek pal ke liye thahar gayi. Ankita ne nazar uthayi toh unhone seedha uski taraf dekha.
Ankita ne jacket uthakar kandhe par rakhi.
Rajeev: Waise… woh log galat bhi nahi keh rahe the. Bina jacket ke tum achhi lagti ho, Ankita.
Ankita ki muskaan halki si kam hui.
Rajeev: Aur sirf kapdon ki baat nahi. Tum dil se bhi bahut khoobsurat ho… aur apni fitness ka bhi achha khayal rakhti ho. Tabhi toh…

Unka adhoora jumla sunte hi Ankita ne baat ka rukh samajh liya. Woh nahi chahti thi ki yeh conversation breakfast table par kisi aur baat tak pahunch jaaye. Rajeev ke aage bolne se pehle hi usne unhe rok diya.
Ankita: Please stop, Uncle. We won't discuss it. Bas.
Rajeev chup ho gaye. Ankita ne jacket pehni aur apna cup uthaya. Karan aur Aman ne ek doosre ko dekha, lekin kisi ne us pal sawal nahi kiya.
07:18 AM

Ankita bedroom ki taraf badhi. Uske dimaag mein Rohan ka jacket joke, Vivek ka shoulder correction, aur Aman ka unexpected sentence ghoom rahe the—par breakfast table ka aakhri adhoora jumla woh wahin chhod dena chahti thi.
Main kar leta.
Woh ek pal ruki, phir khud se muskurakar boli, “Pagal hain dono.” Ab office ke liye taiyaar hona tha.
